models.name: todo_app_users
models.description:
User accounts for the Todo application.

Registered users who can authenticate to the system and manage their personal todo items.
Each user is identified by email and manages their account independently.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's email address used for authentication and identification.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for user authentication. Never stores plain text passwords.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last modified.

models.name: todo_app_user_sessions
models.description:
Authentication sessions for tracking user login activities.

Sessions are created when users authenticate and track connection details for security auditing.
Each session is managed through the authentication flow and expires after configured duration.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the user authenticated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer information for the authentication request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expired or was terminated.

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description:
User's personal todo items represent the core functionality of the todo application.

Each todo item contains a task that an authenticated user wants to track and complete. Todos are strictly owned by individual users with full CRUD permissions for their own items. The system maintains separate todo collections for each user, ensuring complete data privacy.

Todo items support basic task tracking with optional descriptions, completion status tracking, and timestamp audit trails. Users can create unlimited personal tasks and manage them independently without interfering with other users' todo lists.

The main business purpose is to help users organize their daily responsibilities through a simple, reliable task management system.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Todo item title (required field). Must be 1-200 characters.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of the todo item. Can be up to 1000 characters.

plainFields.name: complete
plainFields.description: Completion status of the todo item. True when completed, false when pending.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was first created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was last modified.
